name: Zensical
description: Static site generator for project documentation, built by the creators of Material for MkDocs, that turns Markdown files into a documentation website and can build existing MkDocs projects without changes, improving research software usability through clear documentation.
featureList: Builds static HTML project documentation from Markdown
Uses a TOML configuration file and also reads existing mkdocs.yml configurations
Provides a classic theme matching Material for MkDocs and replacements for common MkDocs plugins
